subject: Hosted onramp: endpoint slicing proposal + next actions
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Ava Laurent <ava.laurent@clearsight.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:12:00Z
Subject: Hosted onramp: endpoint slicing proposal + next actions

Hi Ava —

Really appreciated the product demo earlier today. Quick recap + an actionable onramp for a Hosted API pilot so you can validate latency/cost and then decide whether to move to Dedicated or Private:

1) Sandbox endpoints: we can provision a sandbox project that mirrors production routes (chat, embeddings, rerank). Each route will have its own endpoint URL and token.

2) Rate slicing: propose two slices for the pilot —
  - baseline slice: 5 req/s for functional QA and small-batch traffic
  - burst slice: 25 req/s for peak path testing and scale exercises

3) Data controls & logs: sandbox keeps request logs for 14 days by default; we can enable extended retention for the pilot if you need it for evaluation.

4) Quickstart attachments: I’ve attached a short checklist and the traffic profile template we discussed — please send the completed traffic profile back so we can size the sandbox appropriately.

Next actions I suggest:
- You: confirm whether Hosted API is acceptable for the pilot or if you need a Dedicated trial first (reply by EOD Tue)
- We (Redwood): provision sandbox endpoints and credentials within 48 hours of your confirmation
- Ops call: schedule a 30-min sync for endpoint mapping and quota definitions (Marissa can run the call)

If you prefer, we can also outline what a Dedicated capacity trial would look like (committed GPUs, dedicated SLA) but starting on Hosted is usually fastest for validation.

Attachments: redwood_hosted_quickstart_checklist.pdf (2 pages), clearsight_traffic_profile.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks —
Priyom

From: Ava Laurent <ava.laurent@clearsight.com>

Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@clearsight.com>, DevOps Team <ops@clearsight.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T20:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted onramp: endpoint slicing proposal + next actions

Thanks, Priyom — nice summary. A couple quick clarifications from our side after internal sync: 

- Traffic profile: we’ll fill out the spreadsheet and return it by Friday. Preliminary numbers: expected baseline ~3 req/s across the chat endpoint, with bursts up to ~30 req/s during peak campaign runs. Most calls are small-batch (max 1024 tokens), but a subset will do longer context (4k tokens).

- Security: we prefer VPC peering for any environment that will see production-like data. If Hosted can support a VPC or private peering for the pilot, that would reduce our decision friction.

- SLAs: if Hosted is just an evaluation, fine — but if we see promising results we’ll want to explore Dedicated with an SLA.

We’re fine to start on Hosted for proof-of-concept as long as the sandbox supports the burst slice you outlined and we can restrict access via IP allowlists / token rotation.

Ava
Ava Laurent | Head of Platform | ClearSight Technologies
ava.laurent@clearsight.com | +1 (617) 555-2299

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted onramp: endpoint slicing proposal + next actions

Ava — thanks for the details, that’s helpful. A few concrete notes and options: 

- Token + IP controls: Hosted sandbox supports token rotation and IP allowlisting. We’ll provide step-by-step instructions in the sandbox README.

- VPC/private peering: our Hosted product can support VPC peering in certain regions via a managed peering setup (adds ~2–3 business days to provisioning). If you need an isolated network path right away, we can enable peering for the pilot; Marissa will scope the network requirements with you.

- Endpoints & rate plan: we’ll provision the baseline slice at 5 req/s and the burst slice at 30 req/s to match your upper bound. For the longer-context calls, we’ll set a separate endpoint profile so the runtime uses kernels better suited for 4k sequences (small added cost but lower latency variance).

- Metrics & cost telemetry: sandbox will include per-endpoint token counts and per-request latency histograms. We’ll make the cost estimates available after we review the completed traffic profile.

Next steps:
- Ava: send completed traffic_profile.xlsx by Friday (Nov 6) — we’ll use it to size the sandbox nodes.
- Marissa: can you provision the sandbox + starter tokens once we get the traffic profile? Please also propose two times for a 30-min ops call next week to walk through peering and endpoints.

I’ll also loop Sean on any SLA/dedicated follow-up if you decide to move beyond Hosted after the pilot.

Cheers,
Priyom
